text: put a waterfall halfway down this valley

args.request: put a waterfall halfway down this valley

goals.text: a waterfall about halfway down the east creek valley

ended: Added a waterfall halfway down the creek's valley, in the northeast corner: an 8-tile-wide fall with a 6-level drop, fed by springs, spilling south into the creek 4 tiles below. It clears 4 trees and is 57 tiles from the start. A fall on the creek itself does not fit halfway down (the app keeps falls on one river at least 12 tiles apart); the nearest spot for one is 70% of the way down. Say if you want that instead. Every start rule still holds.
